changes.detail: Description changed (see changes.json for full before/after)
changes.after:
Black and cream in narrow lines. Made from a soft, textured mix-blend knit, this tailored sweater offers cozy warmth. It has a solid black ribbed crew neck, narrow horizontal black and cream white stripes across the body and sleeves, black ribbed cuffs, and a finely ribbed hem. Layer it over a deep burgundy collared shirt with wide-leg denim jeans, black leather sneakers, and a leather shoulder bag. 

Care Instructions:
● Machine or hand-wash up to 30°C/86°F
● Gentle cycle; do not wring or twist
● Do not dry in direct sunlight; do not tumble dry 
● Do not bleach
● Iron with low heat on the reverse side only
